hack.root_cause: Infinite Mint — Blacksmith Farming Contract Withdrawal Bug
hack.description: Cover Protocol's Blacksmith farming contract had a 1-wei withdrawal bug that allowed anyone to mint unlimited COVER tokens — six different exploiters found and used it, inflating supply by 48 quadrillion percent, while Grap Finance minted 40 quintillion tokens and returned the ETH to cosplay as a "white hat."
